AI Search / GEO.what_happened: I’d be careful about using ChatGPT as a proxy for all AI Search. Look at Gemini and Claude in this chart. ChatGPT is…

sources.name: Kevin_Indig
sources.excerpt: I’d be careful about using ChatGPT as a proxy for all AI Search. Look at Gemini and Claude in this chart. ChatGPT is still ahead, but Gemini gained adoption through most of the period. Claude started climbing much faster in early 2026. This is a good reason to check what happens to the same question across different tools. Take a question that came up on a sales call. Ask it in ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude. See who gets recommended and read the sources behind those recommendations. You might find that a competitor barely shows up in ChatGPT but gets recommended regularly in Gemini. I’d want to understand that before telling the team our AI visibility looks good. You’ll need more than one run…
sources.author: @Kevin_Indig
